data.one_liner: Linux implementation of the file_selector plugin for picking and saving files.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Linux platform-specific implementation for the file_selector plugin, enabling file opening, saving, and directory selection dialogs. It is an endorsed federated plugin that is typically included automatically when using the main file_selector package.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application for Linux that requires native file or directory selection dialogs.
You are using the file_selector package and need the Linux backend implementation.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Linux (use the main file_selector or platform-specific packages instead).
You do not need native OS file pickers.
strengths: Endorsed federated plugin that integrates automatically with file_selector.
Provides native Linux file and directory selection dialogs.
weaknesses: Linux-only implementation, requiring other platform packages for cross-platform support.
Requires proper dependencies in pubspec if used directly.
data.setup_notes: Automatically included if you depend on the main file_selector package. Add to pubspec.yaml only if importing package APIs directly.
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:file_selector_linux/file_selector_linux.py';
// Use file_selector APIs normally as an endorsed plugin.
